name: underscores
description: Hi. I'm a starter theme called _s, or underscores, if you like. I'm a theme meant for hacking so don't use me as a Parent Theme. Instead try turning me into the next, most awesome, WordPress theme out there. That's what I'm here for.
author: Automattic Theme Team

scripts.bundle: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('build', { recursive: true })" && dir-archiver --src . --dest build/cooklook.zip --exclude .DS_Store .stylelintrc.json .eslintrc .git .gitattributes .github .gitignore .agents .codex README.md composer.json composer.lock node_modules package-lock.json package.json .travis.yml phpcs.xml.dist phpcs-security.xml.dist tests tools build test.php
scripts.test: php tests/run.php && php tests/account.php && node tests/filters.test.cjs && node tests/comments.test.cjs && node tests/run-js.cjs
